text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry.
To think I'd end up getting injured...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, we cannot afford to change
the schedule over something like this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, it's just a minor scratch, so I think I'll get back to practice after resting a bit.
choice_data_list: For now, get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, it's just a minor scratch, so I think I'll get back to practice after resting a bit.
choice_data_list: For now, get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I just sit around resting,
I'll fall further and further behind schedule...
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, all our efforts will go down the drain.
If it gets worse, all our efforts will go down the drain.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, it seems I was rushing things a bit too much.
For now, I will focus on resting...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I hope the adjustments will be made in time...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if it's just some light running,
I don't think there will be any issue.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...It still aches a bit, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I really need to practice more, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Reminding her firmly not to overdo it, I made sure Eishin Flash got plenty of proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Judging by how things look,
it seems like she'll be all right."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's come up with a new practice routine tailored
to the state of your injury right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash made a safe return
with a reasonable training routine.
